entities.summary: The Étoile Nord-Africaine or ENA was an early Algerian nationalist and Arab nationalist organization founded in 1926. It was dissolved first in 1929, then reorganised in 1933 under the name of Glorieuse ENA and again dissolved in 1937. It is considered a forerunner of the Algerian National Liberation Front (FLN), who fought France during the Algerian War (1954–62).
